title: Bluegate Unit Class Feature Sheet for the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
Each unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is defined by the features below.

| Unit class | Temperature band | Humidity control | Individual door alarm | Gate access hours | Parking at the unit door (drive-up) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | not controlled | none | no | 06:00-22:00 | yes |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | not controlled | none | no | 06:00-22:00 | no |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 55-85 °F | none | no | 06:00-22:00 | no |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 55-80 °F | relative humidity held at 55% or below | no | 06:00-22:00 | no |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 55-80 °F | relative humidity held at 55% or below | yes | 24 hours | yes |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 55-60 °F | relative humidity held between 60% and 70% | yes | 24 hours | no |

## Feature definitions

- **Temperature band** — the band, in degrees Fahrenheit, the unit class is held within.
- **Humidity control** — the relative humidity control of the unit class.
- **Individual door alarm** — whether an individual door alarm is included.
- **Gate access hours** — the gate access hours for the unit class.
- **Drive-up** — whether a vehicle can park directly at the unit door.

## Comparing classes

- Both Standard classes are unconditioned; they differ only in drive-up access, which the Bluegate Drive-Up Standard has and the Bluegate Interior Standard does not.
- Humidity control begins with the Bluegate Climate Plus class.
- Only the Bluegate Premier Climate Suite and the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault include an individual door alarm and 24-hour gate access, and of the two only the Premier Climate Suite offers drive-up access.
